## Checklist

- [ ] Description is supported by the primary source.
- [ ] Setup scope and additional components are clear.
- [ ] Canonical URL and repository catalog match.
- [ ] No private information or credentials are included.
- [ ] Existing entries are preserved unless the change explains their removal.

Listed maintainers may use the optional [Featured in badge](../CONTRIBUTING.md#featured-in-badge) after publication. A badge or backlink is not required for inclusion.
